{{Quote|You're not in bed. You're asleep on my bar... again!|Quinny to Connor Freeman|<ref name="BT2" />}}
'''Quinny''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] who worked as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] on an unspecified [[Freeman Cantina|bar]]. He was friendly with [[Connor Freeman]]&mdash;a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who regularly slept on his counter&mdash;and would often look out for him.<ref name="BT2" />

At one point, a [[Unidentified Gand bounty hunter (Connor Freeman)|certain]] [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] came to the bar and tried to collect the bounty that [[Tayand]]&mdash;a powerful crimelord Freeman owed [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to&mdash;placed on Freeman. Quinny helped Freeman by subtly handing him a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], which Freeman used to shoot the bounty hunter. When Freeman was about to leave, Quinny reminded him to dispose of the dead body.<ref name="BT2" />
